checkpoint.title: Five species, out of Wild Zone 1

events.why: the lab gate asks for five registered species, 3/5 after the tutorial: two new ones here in Wild Zone 1 before leaving, Scatterbug (on the road at 100 from the far gate) and Mareep (in the grass right of the road at 60), so the gate's scene finds 5/5. Patrol 100, 60, 100, 60, ...: walking to 100 and back brings Pokemon back at 60; 10 visits, 10 minutes, 12 throws at most. The party bar's filled slots decide, read before the first stop and after each stop that threw: 5 means done, since every catch is a new species (the plate keeps the throws off species caught) and the "Registered!" banner can be missed. The banner tally is kept for the log and the failure message; the mission panel's counter is not read (catch_in_zone). When the party bar is unread, the tally decides, and the Pokedex's count when the tally is not sure (no reader for its screen yet).

back onto the road at the catch spots (60, and 100 first when further), facing the objective marker. The marker is not on the far gate but past it to its left, behind the zone's fence, so walking at it from 60 gets held up inside the zone.

from 60 the far gate's green pillars are straight down the road, its "A Leave" prompt about 4.7 s away, the marker reading 41 there. Steered by the pillars on screen, after facing 265: at the prompt the camera reads about 259 with the gate right of centre (x 0.68), and after the catches the gate can be off screen.
A Leave, out on the street (a plain scene step would end at once on the gate's prompt with the party bar up)

metadata.source: played step by step from a new game. Ends out on the street just through the far gate; the walk on into the lab is 03.09. Short on species, it fails inside the zone (catch_more_species). A rerun starts from this checkpoint's start save, 03.07's last catch autosave, not from 03.06: each catch here autosaves past that start, so after one catch the start is the backup save (the title's Up + B + X loads the save before the latest), and after two no save holds it. The Pokemon Center counter save, 03.06's start, is written by 03.05's heal and is no longer the backup once 03.07 has caught
